svg.title: Auxiliary logging and complete audit readouts
svg.desc: Initial answers are reused while generated rationales are logged separately. Teacher-forced Yes/No scores for open-weight models provide auxiliary diagnostics, including preference-report mismatch, rather than direct measures of latent belief.

text.tspan: Auxiliary score; not a latent belief.
Dashed: auxiliary logs / scores. Teacher-forced scores are available for open-weight models only.
